text: Got my watch going again for a very fair price. I’ll be back for the next one!
Fast. Good work. Reasonable prices. Recommended.

I took my Chanel watch to this shop because it wasn't working. I'd been to other places, and they said it needed repair (checking and cleaning), which would be quite expensive. So I tried this shop and luckily found a good and skilled technician (who didn't overcharge). In the end, they just replaced the battery and scraped off the corrosion. Now it's working! I only paid for the battery. I'm so happy! I highly recommend this shop. They have good, reliable technicians who don't take advantage of customers.
I stopped by to get my watch battery replaced. It took less than 5 minutes. Professional and affordable.
The shop is on the G floor, Central side. Come down the escalator and you'll see it right away.
